title: crypto2dev CI: ARM64 / Graviton 3 validation
description: Validate that the crypto2dev shim and wolfcrypt.ko build and pass tests on ARM64 (Graviton 3) via ARM64=1 TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1 TEST_LINUXKM=1 ./tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh. ARM64 uses c7g.2xlarge and the arm64 Ubuntu AMI. Key differences: --enable-armasm instead of --enable-intelasm, ARCH=arm64, gcc cross-compile not needed (native arm64 instance). wolfSSL linuxkm uses ARM Crypto Extensions (AES, SHA) via --enable-armasm. Verify: no x86-specific asm in the shim, correct KERN_ARCH=arm64 passed to Kbuild.
notes: ARM64 instance type: c7g.2xlarge (Graviton 3, 8 vCPU). The crypto2dev shim itself is arch-neutral C — the ARM64 test validates that the build system flags and wolfSSL configure options are set correctly for ARM64 in the CI script.
